blind.description: A stylized medieval or fantasy masonry buttress built from stacked stone blocks with a sloped front profile and capped with a smooth, angled stone capstone. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled with softly beveled block edges. Small patches of green moss appear in the mortar seams, and stone colors vary between warm earthy browns, neutral grays, and a few dark slate blocks. The structure rests directly and flatly on the ground without an added plinth or display base.
blind.from_above: Shows a rectangular capstone on the right with the tiered steps of stone blocks extending outward to the left, casting a long shadow upward.
blind.black_or_unpainted_areas: none (a few individual blocks are deliberately textured dark slate gray)
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 6 feet to 6.5 feet tall, slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in scale figure, and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide at the base.
